name: Sonoda Itsumi
source:
A nurse assigned to the surgery department at Jomiya General Hospital.

When Sakaguchi finds out that she is fraternizing with a hospitalized patient, she is blackmailed.

By nature, she is a cheerful and healthy woman. Although she does not bow down to Sakaguchi, she is unable to disobey him out of fear.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1134]Getchu[/url]]
